text: {"assertions":["A conflict loop bug was found in mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift where two clients repeatedly rewrite each other on every sync pass.","The root cause of the conflict loop was an unbounded retry loop with no backoff mechanism in the sync engine.","The fix added exponential backoff with jitter and capped retry attempts, submitted as PR #6442 on branch fix/conflict-loop-1.","The bug could be reproduced by editing the same note on two devices while both are offline.","The fix reduced memory usage from climbing past 9 GB down to 423 MB.","The mobile/ios/SyncEngineTests.swift file contains the test coverage for the sync engine fix.","The issue only appeared on the staging read replica environment.","The mobile sync engine is implemented in Swift."]}
